FULL TEXT:
Department of Food Science & Technology
(NAAC Accredited Grade – A+)
University of Kashmir, Hazratbal Srinagar-190 006.
Date: 07.04.2026
CORRIGENDUM NOTICE
This is with reference to the earlier advertisement issued vide No:
(Advertisement/JKDST) FST/KU/2026 Dated: 09-03-2026 and No:
(Advertisement/SSL/JKDST) FST/KU/2026 Dated: 01.04.2026 for
recruitment under the Department of Science & Technology sanctioned
project titled “Utilization of polysaccharides and Chinar leaves for
designing of hydrogels as a sustainable irrigation system for high
density apple orchard plants” implimented by the Department of Food
Science and Technology, University of Kashmir.
It is hereby informed that there is a revision in the number of positions
required. The earlier advertisement mentioned one (01) position of Junior
Project Fellow (JPF) and one (01) position of Semi-Skilled Labour.
The revised requirement is as follows:
 Two (02) positions of Junior Project Fellow (JPF), @ Rs.
11000/month, consolidated
 One (01) position of Semi-Skilled Labour, @ Rs. 8000/month
consolidated.
Further, the last date for submission of application forms is hereby
extended to 15.04.2026 for both the advertisements. Candidates who have
already applied for the advertised posts need not apply again.
All other terms and conditions of the advertisement shall remain
unchanged.This corrigendum may kindly be treated as part of the original
advertisement.
For any related queries, please contact: 9622709721/ 7006599755.
Dr. Adil Gani
Principal Investigator
